database_note: The player table is the central lookup for individual biographical data. The team table serves as the primary lookup for organizational and seasonal statistics. Event tables like batting, pitching, fielding, and appearances record performance metrics, linking to players via player_id and to teams via team_id and year. Postseason tables similarly connect players to specific rounds and years. Manager tables track managerial stints, joining player_id with team_id and year. Lookup tables include college and park, connected to events via player_college and home_game respectively. The postseason table records series outcomes, linking winning and losing teams. Salary data connects players to teams and years. Most tables rely on composite keys involving player_id, year, and team_id to ensure unique records for specific contexts.
